purpose: Project existing text-generation and local-edit tasks into the generic scene draft

textGeneration: The task text is stored as a text_brief source.
Brief dimensions, openings, style and furniture become IntentSpec constraints.
The compiled shell and candidate plans become SceneProgram revisions.
Catalogue furniture receives catalogCandidates asset resolutions.
localEdit: The current project revision becomes a project_import baseline source.
The user task becomes IntentSpec with target and addition constraints.
The baseline and accepted candidate states are projected into SceneProgram.
The formal candidate remains the authority until later migration.

notClaimed: Generic draft as formal commit source
